items.t: Exploits Arrive in “10 to 15 Minutes,” Patches in 45 Days, per Cisco’s Jeetu Patel. Cue CrowdStrike
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCisco’s Jeetu Patel says attackers can exploit a newly announced software flaw within 10 to 15 minutes, while patching takes about 45 days. Patching faster brings its own risk, as recent outages at JPMorgan Chase and Microsoft show.

items.t: Wall Street Analysts Think Cisco (CSCO) Is a Good Investment: Is It?
